| Service Tier | 2026 Los Angeles Rate | Minimum / Billing | Scope Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 1: Rough Construction Clean | $0.15 – $0.22 / sq ft | $450 minimum | Framing/subfloor debris sweep, sticker/plastic removal, initial HEPA vacuuming |
| Phase 2: Final Detail Construction Clean | $0.20 – $0.35 / sq ft | $450 minimum | Full HEPA silica/drywall dust capture, cabinet/drawer interiors, stucco/paint/silicone removal, glass & stone polish |
| Phase 3: Puff / Touch-Up Clean | $0.08 – $0.15 / sq ft | $350 minimum | Final microfiber dust wipe & glass polish 24 hrs before Certificate of Occupancy or homeowner handover |
| Full 3-Phase Post-Construction Package | $0.28 – $0.45 / sq ft | $450 minimum | Complete Rough + Final + Puff package for general contractors, ADUs, custom estates, and commercial TI buildouts |
| Commercial Office & Retail Janitorial | $0.09 – $0.22 / sq ft | $350 / month | Nightly/weekly commercial janitorial, restroom sanitization, breakrooms, glass partitions, floor care |
| Move-In / Move-Out & Deep Cleaning | $0.16 – $0.35 / sq ft | $260 – $720+ | Empty-property or post-remodel deep sanitization inside appliances, cabinets, baseboards, and window tracks |
